question: Sachin Tendulkar scored his 100th international cricket against which team?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bangladesh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• ​Sachin Tendulkar scripted records on this day in 2012 by becoming the primary-ever cricketer to score a hundred international centuries even as playing in the Asia Cup against **Bangladesh.**
 
• The milestone came at the Sher-e-Bangla Stadium in Dhaka towards Bangladesh inside the Asia Cup.</
